codes.0: unknown / no verified road access or building interior
codes.1: candidate safe with dry shelter access through forecast

assumptions.population: synthetic; not census or real tracks
assumptions.shelters: source-road candidate points; suitability and capacity assumed
assumptions.pedestrian_rule: depth <0.15m and speed <0.5m/s at segment traversal time, illustrative only
assumptions.routing: source-road graph, plan with 10-minute lookahead and recheck each segment at crossing time; bridges and traffic rules unverified
assumptions.safe_zone_rule: outdoor grid, future 30min + 60s bin buffer: h<0.08m, v<0.25m/s and dry road connection within 90m to a shelter
assumptions.danger_rule: h>=0.30m or h>0.05m and (v>=1m/s or h*v>=0.15m2/s); illustrative classification, not an official safety standard
assumptions.patrols: synthetic teams on roads dry throughout the modeled window; timed checks and guidance dwell
assumptions.capacity: reserved en route and occupied at arrival; groups may wait if no safe route/capacity
assumptions.outside: outside hydraulic extent unassessed; never labeled safe
